entities.name: Solon
entities.description: A scholar and athlete, the chosen champion of Oxus, who keeps a diary of his journey into the great labyrinth to find a treasure.

entities.name: Oxus
entities.description: Solon's polis, a small city on the outskirts of Meletis, which sent him as its champion.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city near which Solon's home lies.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: A sea whose coastline Solon followed at the start of his journey.

entities.name: Phaela
entities.description: A small village where the road ends, the last remains of civilization on Solon's way to the labyrinth.

entities.name: The Labyrinth
entities.description: A vast hedge maze with a hidden treasure at its center, with changing terrain, an underground tomb section and a stalking beast.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god Solon prays to and credits with defending him.

entities.name: Thassa's Dekella
entities.description: A treasure that the sages say lies at the center of the labyrinth.

entities.name: Praxitelius
entities.description: A former champion of Oxus who did not return two years ago; Solon finds his remains in the labyrinth.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god who Solon believes contrives to end his journey.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: A god who Solon believes contrives to end his journey.

events.summary: Solon travels south from his home and reaches the great labyrinth at sunset.
events.quote: As the sun set, I crested a grassy hill and came upon the great labyrinth.

events.summary: Solon explains that as Oxus's chosen champion he must enter the labyrinth and retrieve the treasure said to lie at its center.
events.quote: It is my duty, as the chosen champion of Oxus, to venture inside, find the wondrous treasure hidden within, and return, victorious.

events.summary: Solon enters the labyrinth and follows his map, passing signs of earlier explorers.
events.quote: I entered the labyrinth today, shortly after dawn.

events.summary: Solon spends a sleepless night exposed in the maze.
events.quote: I held my long knife in my hand all night and tried to breathe silently.

events.summary: Solon finds the body of Praxitelius, a former champion of Oxus, and takes his blessed-looking dagger.
events.quote: My most interesting discovery of the day was the body of Praxitelius, a former champion of Oxus.

events.summary: Beyond the end of his map, Solon is stalked and chased by an unseen beast.
events.quote: But the creature stalked me for the next several hours.

events.summary: Solon escapes through a collapsed hedge but loses his arrows and food.
events.quote: I had not only lost the beast, I had also lost my quiver of arrows and bags of dried fruit and meat.

events.summary: Lost for two days and low on water, Solon reaches a stone door leading down into the dark.
events.quote: Inside the door, a stone staircase leads down, into the dark.

events.summary: Solon passes through an underground tomb-maze of corpses and vermin by candlelight and emerges outside.
events.quote: Yet I pressed on and eventually came to another stone staircase leading up and, finally, outside.

events.summary: A great storm breaks; Solon sees the gods in the lightning and believes Erebos and Nylea oppose him while Thassa defends him.
events.quote: Erebos and Nylea contrive to end my journey here, while Thassa herself defends me.
